answer:
The simulation uses OpenFOAM's reactingParcelFoam solver in 2D axisymmetric mode for a transient spray combustion case.
The chamber is a cylinder of 0.2 m axial length and 0.1 m diameter; the computational domain is the half-section from the axis to the outer wall.
The mesh is generated with blockMesh as a single block of 100 cells in the axial direction and 50 cells in the radial direction, with geometric grading applied so that cells are finer near the axis (r = 0) and near the injector face (z = 0).
The turbulence model is k-epsilon with standard constants; k and epsilon are initialized to 0.05 m²/s² and 0.15 m/s respectively, with standard wall functions on solid boundaries.
The inlet boundary at z = 0 uses fixedValue for velocity (10, 0, 0) m/s, fixedValue 800 K for temperature, fixedValue 101325 Pa for pressure, and fixedValue mass fractions of 0.233 for O2 and 0.767 for N2.
The outlet boundary at z = 0.2 m uses totalPressure (101325 Pa) for pressure and zeroGradient for velocity, temperature, and all species mass fractions.
The outer cylindrical wall at r = 0.05 m uses noSlip for velocity and fixedValue 400 K for temperature.
The axis at r = 0 uses the axis boundary type for velocity and zeroGradient for all scalar fields.
The thermodynamic library is set to janaf in constant/thermophysicalProperties and constant/combustionProperties.
The combustion model is a two-step global reaction mechanism defined in constant/reactionSchemes: Step 1 is C12H26 + 10 O2 → 6 CO + 6 CO2 + 13 H2O with an Arrhenius rate constant A = 1.0e7 m³/(mol·s), activation energy Ea = 35000 J/mol, and reaction order 1 in fuel and 1 in O2; Step 2 is CO + 0.5 O2 → CO2 with A = 1.0e7 m³/(mol·s), Ea = 0 J/mol, and reaction order 1 in CO and 1 in O2.
The spray is injected at the center of the inlet face (r = 0, z = 0) using a cone injection model with a half-angle of 15 degrees.
The droplet size distribution is Rosin-Rammler with a mean diameter of 50 microns and a spread parameter m = 1.2.
The spray mass flow rate is 0.002 kg/s, the initial droplet temperature is 300 K, and the injection is continuous for the full simulation duration.
The number of Lagrangian parcels per injection cycle is 20000.
Heat and mass transfer between gas and droplets use the RanzMarshall correlation; aerodynamic drag uses the standard spherical drag model.
The time controls are: application reactingParcelFoam, adjustableRunTime yes, maxCo 0.7, endTime 0.05 s, writeControl time, writeInterval 0.001 s.
The initial gas field is uniform at 800 K, 101325 Pa, with O2 mass fraction 0.233 and N2 mass fraction 0.767, and zero velocity everywhere except the inlet.
